scope.reviewer: Fresh-context independent integration reviewer; no implementation ownership
scope.target: personal-ai-skills 1.1.0 six P2/P3 additions, validator extension, installed-byte preservation and recorded explicit Codex pilots
scope.boundary: Read-only source/evidence inspection, first-party checks with -B, no network, browser, third-party source hooks, installation or publication. Only this report written.

findings.issue: Invalid UTC offset minutes are silently normalized into a different deadline.

reproduction.expected: Reject malformed ISO offset with JSON REWORK; do not infer an intended timezone.

findings.impact: A typo such as +07:99 is accepted as +08:39 by datetime.fromisoformat, giving a precise but unsupported deadline interval. The stated interface requires ISO8601 offsets. Same parser is used for as_of.
findings.recommendation: Explicitly validate offset component ranges before parsing for both inputs; add positive boundary and negative regression tests, then refresh hashes/receipts through the authorized correction workflow.

findings.issue: Calendar-boundary timezone conversion raises an uncaught OverflowError instead of the JSON error result.

reproduction.actual: Exit 1, empty stdout, OverflowError: date value out of range traceback on stderr.
reproduction.expected: Document/reject unsupported arithmetic range and return structured REWORK.

findings.impact: Extreme calendar inputs break the CLI JSON contract; ordinary business deadlines and heldout pilots are unaffected.
findings.recommendation: Catch or translate arithmetic range errors and add lower/upper year-boundary regressions.
